title: Microsoft.Entra/applications/extensionProperties
description: A directory extension definition registered on an application. The child name is the short extension name; Graph stores it as extension_<appId without dashes>_<name> (reference(...).name). Every property is immutable: a change deletes and recreates the extension (confirmation required), and a delete makes the values stored on every target object unreachable.

name.description: Set from the resource name (the short name, without the extension_<appId>_ prefix); declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name.

dataType.description: Required: the type of the values (Binary up to 256 bytes, Boolean, DateTime in ISO 8601, Integer 32-bit, LargeInteger 64-bit, String up to 256 characters). Immutable.

targetObjects.description: Required: the directory objects that can hold a value (PascalCase). Immutable.

isMultiValued.description: Whether the extension holds a collection of dataType values. Defaults to false (create only). Immutable.
